verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated POS testing system that simulates transaction scenarios before going live. It also offers an orderable Adyen test card from the test Customer Area for testing card brands, CVMs and declined payments, which satisfies the story's test-card-environment option. The docs call the system 'basic', and nothing shows a software-simulated reader or independent hands-on use. Missing for 10: a documented simulated/virtual terminal option, detail on end-to-end scenario coverage beyond brands/CVMs/declines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live

citations.quote: We provide a basic testing system to simulate transaction scenarios and functionalities. You can use this system to ensure your test integration is working as expected, before you switch to an integration that can make live transactions.
You can order an Adyen test card from your test Customer Area... Using the Adyen test card, you can: Test different card brands. Test different CVMs. Test declined payments.
